title: FCH protocell SIBW replicates on seed 3 (contrast 17-29x, chi=0 1.1x), but a barrier-free solute with uniformly lowered D is also held at 14x
summary: Fresh seed 3: five bilayer vesicles nucleate from white noise by t~32 and persist to t=800; three (tracks #4-#6) keep a gold solute-filled lumen throughout, two grow into multilamellar onions. Lumen/outside contrast (author's contrast.py) is >= 2 on 100% of frames, 29 at t=640 falling to 17 at t=800 as solute accumulates outside. The chi=0 ablation on seed 3 gives 1.12 at t=800 (>=2 on 16% of frames). As the matched control for a gate I ran chi=0 with the solute's diffusivity lowered uniformly: Dc=0.1 holds 2.6x and Dc=0.01 holds 14.4x on every frame, with the solute sitting in and around the bilayer instead of in a clean lumen. W passes its rubric gate but is not beyond diffusion.

observations.B: rerun/tracks.png: cyan amphiphile bilayer ring around a solvent lumen on #4-#6 throughout; #7 becomes a multilamellar onion
observations.W: contrast.txt (rerun): lumen/outside 17-29x on 100% of frames; chi0/ on the same seed 1.12 at t=800

controls_run.W: chi0/ (barrier ablated, seed 3) and lowD01/, lowD001/ (chi=0 with Dc x0.1 and x0.01: matched lowered-D twin)

verdicts.limitation: The matched lowered-D control keeps the contrast (2.6x at Dc 0.1, 14.4x at Dc 0.01), so containment here is not beyond diffusion: the barrier is equivalent to a slow solute; I did not set bd_supported. Contrast decays over the run as the outside fills (29 -> 17 on seed 3), 2 of 5 vesicles are multilamellar onions with little lumen, the solute is passive (osm=0), and I did not re-run the 1.5x resolution arm.
